themes_detail.label: Drug Activity Surge
themes_detail.summary: Drug activity complaints spiked to 4 reports THIS WEEK compared to a 0.9 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 357% increase (z-score: 5.21)—signaling a potential new or accelerating public safety concern in Fort Greene/Brooklyn Heights requiring immediate investigation.
evidence: 4 drug activity complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
No recent local news coverage or Reddit discussion documenting this trend
reporting_angles: Interview NYPD and community residents about locations and timing of reported drug activity; determine if complaints cluster in specific parks or blocks
Contact local precinct to understand response protocols and any ongoing operations related to this spike

themes_detail.label: Obstruction Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Obstruction complaints jumped to 8 reports THIS WEEK versus a 3.0 weekly average—a 167% increase (z-score: 3.54)—indicating emerging sidewalk or public-space blockage issues affecting pedestrian access across the district.
evidence: 8 obstruction complaints THIS WEEK vs. 3.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Street Condition is the 5th-highest category overall (616 complaints over 90 days), suggesting chronic infrastructure challenges may be worsening
reporting_angles: Map the 8 new obstruction complaints to identify geographic hotspots—are they concentrated around parks, development sites, or specific streets?
Examine whether obstruction complaints correlate with the 1,252 DOB permit filings (902 alterations) suggesting construction activity is blocking public access

themes_detail.label: Noise in Parks Explodes
themes_detail.summary: Park noise complaints surged to 4 reports last week versus a 0.1 weekly baseline—a 3,100% spike (z-score: 11.72)—marking an exceptional and statistically severe anomaly in outdoor recreation space use or events.
evidence: 4 park noise complaints last week vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
3,100% spike (z-score: 11.72, highest z-score among all spikes—severity: high)
Outdoor Dining also spiked 500% to 3 complaints last week, suggesting increased outdoor activity or events may be driving noise
reporting_angles: Identify which parks generated the 4 complaints and what events or activities were occurring—concerts, festivals, construction, or increased weekend use?
Interview Parks Department on any new or expanded permit approvals for outdoor events in Fort Greene Park or Brooklyn Heights Promenade

themes_detail.label: Trees Dying Across District
themes_detail.summary: Dead or dying tree complaints increased to 7 reports last week versus a 1.2 weekly average—a 460% spike (z-score: 5.28)—potentially indicating disease, extreme weather impact, or deferred maintenance in Parks Department oversight.
evidence: 7 dead/dying tree complaints last week vs. 1.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Community Board repeatedly requests 'New equipment for maintenance' from Parks & Recreation—suggesting chronic capacity or resource gaps
reporting_angles: Survey the 7 specific tree complaint locations; identify if complaints cluster on particular blocks or park areas suggesting a discrete cause (pest infestation, environmental stress, or neglect)
Interview Parks Department arborist about disease surveillance, recent weather impacts, and maintenance backlog; cross-check with CB budget requests to assess resource constraints

themes_detail.label: Electrical Infrastructure Strain
themes_detail.summary: Electrical complaints jumped to 6 reports three weeks ago versus a 0.9 weekly average—a 586% spike (z-score: 4.87)—suggesting potential grid stress, aging infrastructure, or increased demand in the district.
evidence: 6 electrical complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
1,252 DOB permits filed in last 90 days (902 alterations, 109 new buildings) may be straining electrical capacity in already-dense neighborhoods
reporting_angles: Contact Con Edison to determine if recent electrical complaints relate to outages, brownouts, or work on grid infrastructure upgrades
Cross-reference the 6 electrical complaints with DOB permits to assess whether construction activity is triggering infrastructure failures
